company.name: Compyle
company.shortDescription: Compyle connects businesses to buy and sell products and services
company.description: Compyle assists brands, manufacturers, retailers, hotels, and restaurants in streamlining their purchasing and distribution processes. Almost everything is purchased online via e-commerce websites, while B2B purchasing and sales remain predominantly offline. Compyle was created to make B2B shopping as simple as ordering. They want to make it easier for qualified firms to identify and purchase products from authorized suppliers. Their team has decades of collective experience in manufacturing, procurement, and brand creation.
